answer: Trust is ferrous and it must be earned in contact. Every new identity starts at the foot of a ridge and can only transact upward, with established partners; each climb step requires a whisper, a signed note that the partner genuinely worked with this identity on a task the partner already logged. Whisper notes are non-transferable and bound to the partner's own record, so a cluster cannot fabricate them for its members. The k-th climb step costs k times the bond, so n heads face roughly n squared and each still needs a real partner willing to spend their own name.
